overview_description: List, create, read, update and delete additional codes, the data sets used on purchase order lines.
intro: Additional codes are the extra reference codes you can set on purchase order lines. You can list, create, read, update and delete them. This area has 5 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
notes: **Requests and responses wrap the record in `additional_code`.** A create sends `{"additional_code": {...}}` and a read returns the record under the same key.
**`name` is the one required field on a create.**
**An additional code `id` starts with `ac_`.** Use that `id` in the path of a read, an update or a delete.
**Listings page by cursor.** Records sit under `data`; pass `pagination.next_cursor` as `cursor` to read the next page, and stop when `pagination.has_more` is `false`.
**A delete returns `204` with no body.** Reading the additional code afterwards returns `404`.

endpoints.title: List additional codes
endpoints.summary: Returns a page of additional codes under `data`, with paging details under `pagination`.
endpoints.description: Lists the additional codes, the data sets of purchase order lines. Pass `limit` to set the page size, and while `pagination.has_more` is true pass `pagination.next_cursor` back as `cursor` to read the next page. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` or `filter_<field>_<operator>`, and `sort` orders the results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the next one.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

200.description: A page of additional codes, under `data`.

endpoints.title: Create an additional code
endpoints.summary: Creates an additional code and returns it under `additional_code`.
endpoints.description: Send the new additional code under `additional_code`. `name` is required.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an additional code
endpoints.summary: Returns one additional code by its `id`, under `additional_code`.
endpoints.description: Reads the additional code with this `ac_` `id`.

parameters.name: additional_code_id
parameters.description: The additional code's `ac_` `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

endpoints.title: Delete an additional code
endpoints.summary: Deletes an additional code. The response has no body.
endpoints.description: Deletes the additional code with this `id`. Reading the same `id` afterwards returns `404`.

parameters.name: additional_code_id
parameters.description: The additional code's `ac_` `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

204.description: The additional code is deleted. The response has no body.

endpoints.title: Update an additional code
endpoints.summary: Changes the fields or the status of an additional code.
endpoints.description: Send the fields to change under `additional_code`. You can change its fields or its `status`. This call currently returns `500`; read the additional code again to see whether the change is stored.

parameters.name: additional_code_id
parameters.description: The additional code's `ac_` `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

endpoints.warning: **This call currently returns `500`.** Read the additional code again to see whether the change is stored.

limit.description: The page size applied to this page.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Trust this over `next_cursor`, which can still be set on the last page.

next_cursor.description: Pass this back as `cursor` to read the next page.
